extraction.Name: Thomas Morgan
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged for $700 but allottee says he only received payments of about $20.00 each time. Land sold to satisfy mortgages.
extraction.Buyer: Land was sold to settle indebtedness with C. E. Vandervoort, Sr.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Rent income of $30 per year. Only annuity paid to the Pawnee Tribe.
extraction.NOTES: Date and manner of delivery of patent 12-26-1917; receipted for yes; patent recorded in Pawnee County, Okla. by G.E. Vandervoort, Sr.; only wife dependent upon allottee for support; it appears that the allottee was defrauded of his land by C. E. Vandervoort, Sr., who is now dead; not very good physical/mental condition; no property and no money accumulated; document notarized November 26, 1928, Pawnee County, Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929; file reference 47022/20A
